meta.boundary: round-5 proposal (scratchpad/round5/world-data/geometry.json: 130 m route bands + door/start/building circles), building centroid inside
meta.method: non-residential = OSM building type not residential/garage/shed, or any shop/amenity/office/tourism tag on it or a business node inside/at it (mixed-use blocks with ground-floor shops included). Storeys: research > OSM building:levels > dossier estimate. Facade colour: research photo hex > OSM building:colour > dossier palette estimate > archetype default (basis given per field). Ground-floor height, window rhythm, rooftop items: rules by archetype (low confidence). Signage: businesses-bucharest-floreasca.json (brand colours/styles, locator checks). Confidence: high = photo-researched facade or CV-stop building; medium = OSM levels + named business/name; low = rule-based.
